description: Source code for the ContentDefinitionService class in OrchardCore, managing content types, parts, and fields including creation, removal, and ordering.

classes.name: ContentDefinitionService
classes.description: Implements IContentDefinitionService; manages content types, parts, and fields including creation, removal, and ordering.

methods.name: LoadTypesAsync
methods.description: Loads all content type definitions and returns them as view models, ordered by display name.

methods.name: GetTypesAsync
methods.description: Lists all content type definitions as view models, ordered by display name.

methods.name: LoadTypeAsync
methods.description: Loads a specific content type definition by name, returns as view model or null if not found.

methods.name: GetTypeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content type definition by name, returns as view model or null if not found.

methods.name: AddTypeAsync
methods.description: Creates a new content type with specified name and display name, ensuring unique naming and raising event handlers.

methods.name: RemoveTypeAsync
methods.description: Removes a content type and its associated parts, unless it is system-defined, and raises event handlers.

methods.name: AddPartToTypeAsync
methods.description: Attaches a part to a content type and raises event handlers.

methods.name: AddReusablePartToTypeAsync
methods.description: Adds a reusable part with display name and description to a content type, raising event handlers.

methods.name: RemovePartFromTypeAsync
methods.description: Detaches a part from a content type, unless system-defined, and raises event handlers.

methods.name: LoadPartsAsync
methods.description: Loads content parts, including user-defined and code-defined, ordered by display name.

methods.name: GetPartsAsync
methods.description: Lists content parts, including user-defined and code-defined, ordered by display name.

methods.name: LoadPartAsync
methods.description: Loads a content part by name, creating a default if not found.

methods.name: GetPartAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a content part by name, creating a default if not found.

methods.name: AddPartAsync
methods.description: Creates a new content part from a view model, raising event handlers.

methods.name: RemovePartAsync
methods.description: Removes a content part unless system-defined, and raises event handlers.

methods.name: GetFieldsAsync
methods.description: Returns available field types.

methods.name: AddFieldToPartAsync
methods.description: Adds a field to a part with specified name, type, and display name, raising event handlers.

methods.name: RemoveFieldFromPartAsync
methods.description: Removes a field from a part unless system-defined, and raises event handlers.

methods.name: AlterFieldAsync
methods.description: Updates a field's display name, editor, and display mode, raising event handlers.

methods.name: AlterTypePartAsync
methods.description: Updates a type part's display name, description, editor, and display mode, raising event handlers.

methods.name: AlterTypePartsOrderAsync
methods.description: Reorders parts within a content type and raises event handlers.

methods.name: AlterPartFieldsOrderAsync
methods.description: Reorders fields within a part and raises event handlers.

methods.name: GenerateContentTypeNameFromDisplayNameAsync
methods.description: Generates a unique content type name from a display name.

methods.name: GenerateFieldNameFromDisplayNameAsync
methods.description: Generates a unique field name within a part or type from a display name.

methods.name: VersionName
methods.description: Appends or increments a version suffix in a name string.
